command.cdp.minimum_exceeds_maximum: Minimum percentages cannot exceed their matching maximum percentages.
command.cdp.rules.summary: CDP rules: drop chance=%s, durability-loss chance=%s, stack drop=%s-%s, experience loss=%s-%s, durability loss=%s-%s
command.cdp.rules.slots: Slot dropping: armor=%s, main hand=%s, off hand=%s, other hotbar slots=%s
command.cdp.rules.insurance: Insurance and limits: stack=%s, non-stackable=%s, durability=%s, durability loss=%s, maximum experience orbs=%s
command.cdp.help.overview: CDP help: use /cdp help command to list commands, or /cdp help parameter <parameter> for one parameter.
command.cdp.help.command.get: /cdp get: View the current global rules.
command.cdp.help.command.help: /cdp help command or /cdp help parameter <parameter>: View help.
command.cdp.help.command.reset: /cdp reset: Reset all rules and clear the whitelist; requires permission level 4.
command.cdp.help.command.set: /cdp set <parameter> <value>: Change one rule; requires permission level 4.
command.cdp.help.command.whitelist: /cdp whitelist add|remove|list: Manage the item whitelist; requires permission level 4.
command.cdp.help.parameter.dropChance: Range: 0.0–1.0. Probability that each item slot allowed to drop passes its drop check. Default: 0.5.
command.cdp.help.parameter.minDropPerc: Range: 0.0–1.0 and no greater than MaxDropPerc. Lower bound for a stackable item's random drop percentage. Default: 0.1.
command.cdp.help.parameter.maxDropPerc: Range: 0.0–1.0 and no less than MinDropPerc. Upper bound for a stackable item's random drop percentage. Default: 0.5.
command.cdp.help.parameter.minExperience: Range: 0.0–1.0 and no greater than MaxExperienceLossPerc. Lower bound for the death experience-loss percentage. Default: 0.1.
command.cdp.help.parameter.maxExperience: Range: 0.0–1.0 and no less than MinExperienceLossPerc. Upper bound for the death experience-loss percentage. Default: 0.5.
command.cdp.help.parameter.doArmorDrop: Options: true / false. Whether the four armor slots may drop. Default: false.
command.cdp.help.parameter.doMainhandDro: Options: true / false. Whether the selected main-hand hotbar slot may drop. Default: false.
command.cdp.help.parameter.doOffhandDrop: Options: true / false. Whether the off-hand slot may drop. Default: false.
command.cdp.help.parameter.doToolbarDrop: Options: true / false. Whether the other eight unselected hotbar slots may drop. Default: true.
command.cdp.help.parameter.stackInsuranc: Options: true / false. Whether stackable items retain their final item. Default: true.
command.cdp.help.parameter.nonStackableI: Options: true / false. Whether non-stackable items are prevented from dropping as whole items after a successful drop check. Default: true.
command.cdp.help.parameter.doDurabilityL: Options: true / false. Whether damageable non-stackable items make an independent durability-loss check. Default: true.
command.cdp.help.parameter.durabilityLos: Range: 0.0–1.0. Probability that the independent durability-loss check succeeds. Default: 0.5.
command.cdp.help.parameter.minDurability: Range: 0.0–1.0 and no greater than MaxDurabilityLossPerc. Lower bound for the durability-loss percentage. Default: 0.05.
command.cdp.help.parameter.maxDurability: Range: 0.0–1.0 and no less than MinDurabilityLossPerc. Upper bound for the durability-loss percentage. Default: 0.2.
command.cdp.help.parameter.durabilityIns: Options: true / false. Whether durability loss retains at least 1 durability point. Default: true.
command.cdp.help.parameter.maxExperience: Options: integer 1–2147483647. Maximum experience-orb entities created by one death. Default: 10.
command.cdp.help.parameter.whiteList: Manage it with /cdp whitelist add <item>, remove <item>, and list. Add accepts registered items only; remove completes the current whitelist and can clear stale IDs.
